NBA Investigates Kawhi Leonard and Clippers for Salary Cap Circumvention

The NBA has concluded its investigation into Kawhi Leonard and the Los Angeles Clippers regarding allegations of salary cap circumvention. The league announced on Wednesday that it has issued punishments to Leonard, his associates, and team executives. The specific details of the investigation and the penalties imposed were not disclosed in the provided coverage.
